meta.setIdentity: Romantic Alley Mixtape with memorable micro-peaks: every song keeps CHILI LAB intimacy but owns one 8-15 second signature moment.
meta.crossSetDifferentiation: Preserve v3 diversity: do not converge on Rhodes + rounded bass + low-mid chest vocal. Genre, groove, signature instrument and vocal phonation must remain distributed across the 15 tracks.
meta.killingPointPolicy: Every track must contain one memorable 8-15 second Signature Moment. Killing points are created with silence, rhythmic displacement, signature riffs, harmonic surprise, vocal-distance change, duet entrance, bass removal/return or final-hook variation instead of louder drums, belts or EDM drops. Do not reuse the same mechanism on adjacent tracks.
meta.anchorPolicy: Tracks 2, 9 and 14 are anchor tracks at 9/10 killing-point strength. They are not louder than the rest; they are more memorable because hook, arrangement interruption and signature instrumental response align in one moment.
meta.hookPolicy: Core hooks should usually be 2-6 words, appear at least twice, and receive a changed rhythm, harmony, vocal role or instrumental answer in the final occurrence.
meta.antiFlatnessPolicy: Reject any track whose verse and chorus feel identical in density for the entire song. Each song needs one controlled contrast event, but the playlist must remain low-to-mid energy.
meta.genrePolicy: Use genuinely different groove grammars: trip-hop soul, soft 2-step garage, bossa-lofi jazz-hop, noir jazz-hop, neo-soul chill rap, acoustic soul-hop, microhouse soul, lo-fi jazz-soul duet, broken-beat future-jazz, tape-soul alt-R&B, daytime jazz-hop, dub-house, ambient garage, smoky jazz-soul duet and dream-soul downtempo.
meta.instrumentPolicy: Rotate Wurlitzer, upright piano, nylon guitar, baritone guitar, Hammond, vibraphone, muted trumpet, marimba, fretless bass, organ bubble, tape piano, cello pizzicato, mellow flute and tremolo guitar. Each killing point should preferably use the track's signature instrument rather than a generic riser.
meta.vocalPolicy: Keep vocals intimate but rotate smoky contralto, tenor-baritone, clear mezzo, grainy baritone, velvet alto, chest-mix tenor and asymmetric duets. Killing points may move the vocal closer, change singer, change articulation or add one low harmony, but no belt/falsetto climax.
meta.energyArc: 1-5 intimate and close, 6-10 more mobile and colorful, 11-15 deeper and nocturnal. The signature moment should change attention, not turn the track into a different loudness class.
meta.revisionNoteKo: v3의 장르·보컬·리듬 다양성은 유지하면서 '곡은 다르지만 기억에 꽂히는 순간이 없다'는 문제를 해결했다. 15곡 모두 8~15초 Signature Moment를 부여했고, 2·9·14번은 9/10 앵커곡으로 설계했다. 모든 곡에 같은 드럼 드롭을 반복하지 않고 침묵, 베이스 복귀, 2~4음 리프, 화성 반전, 보컬 거리 변화, 듀엣 진입, dub echo 등 서로 다른 킬링포인트 메커니즘을 분산했다.

songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Half a block in, the sky gives up its holding,
and we duck beneath a green shop awning, laughing.
You tell me we could make it, four doors down,
I tell you your shoes have other plans tonight.
So we stay there, shoulder close to shoulder,
your sleeve against mine when the cold wind turns,
and I forget the seven ways I meant to say it.

[Pre-Chorus]
There's a thing I've carried up this lane all week,
and the rain is loud enough to make me brave,
your hand rests near mine on the metal rail.

[Chorus]
I say it to the pavement, then to you,
you keep your eyes on me and smile so small,
like you already knew and let me get there,
Wait Out the Rain.

[Verse 2]
You answer with a question, soft and easy,
the kind that leaves the whole of me with room.
A scooter throws a ribbon down the middle,
somebody's kitchen fan is breathing garlic.
The gutter runs a silver thread beside us,
five minutes pass and neither of us moves,
and when the dripping stops your shoulder stays with mine.

[Instrumental Break - 8 bars]

[Final Chorus]
Wait Out the Rain,
you say it back like something we can keep,
we've got a street of doors and nowhere else to hurry,
so let the evening take its time with us,
keep your sleeve against my sleeve a little longer,
Wait Out the Rain.

[Verse 1]
Your gate is thirty steps from where we're standing,
and I can see the bulb above the door.
The taxi at the corner isn't mine,
the bus I said I'd catch went by at ten.
I've got a sentence folded in my pocket,
but your hand is warm inside your coat beside me,
and I know I'm not ready for goodnight.

[Signature Pause - one beat]
[Chorus]
One More Block,
I hear myself before I've made a choice,
you smile and turn away from your own doorway,
just walk it slow and stay beside me now.

The bakery is dark, the laundry sign is humming,
a cat goes flat beneath a parked-up van.
We pass your gate and neither of us mentions it,
your shoulder finds mine once at the crossing.
You say the cold is getting worse tonight,
then tuck your hand around my sleeve and laugh,
and somehow that becomes another block.

One More Block,
the streetlights make a little room for us,
your gate can wait another row of windows,
just walk it slow and stay beside me now.

[Final Chorus]
One More Block,
[Female Low Response: one more]
the night is not demanding much of us,
if goodbye waits beyond the next streetlight,
we'll reach it when we reach it, hand in hand,
One More Block.

[Verse 1]
Behind the bakery the lane runs narrow,
so we walk it single file and then we don't.
You take two steps for every one I'm taking,
then turn and walk backward just to make me laugh.
I speed up, you slow down, we get it wrong,
and your shoulder catches mine beneath a window.

Halfway down we somehow find the rhythm,
neither leading, neither falling far behind.

[Chorus]
Warm trays come out and fill the lane with sugar,
Step for Step,
your hand keeps brushing mine like it's an accident,
and neither of us seems to want it fixed.

You point out where the wall has kept its posters,
four years of shows in layers, gone to paste.
I tell you what I noticed on the corner,
you tell me I miss everything that matters.
The oven fan is pushing out the sweetness,
and when the lane gets narrow you move closer,
like we have always known exactly where to walk.

[Chorus]
Warm trays come out and fill the lane with sugar,
Step for Step,
your hand keeps brushing mine like it's an accident,
and neither of us seems to want it fixed.

[Final Chorus]
Step for Step,
the lane runs out and puts us on the street,
but our shoulders keep the rhythm we just found,
so take the long way back and stay this close,

[Verse 1]
Every shutter's down along the arcade,
the fruit stand has a tarp across its face.
My own footsteps come back off the ceiling,
about a half a beat behind the ones I take.
I pass the window where you stopped last Sunday,
and text you that the pink sign is still on,
like the street kept one small light for us.

[Pre-Chorus]
This is where we walked when it was crowded,
and even empty I can hear you next to me.

[Chorus]
Nobody's here to tell me where to turn,
so I go slowly through the places that were ours,
past the window with the same three shoes,
All the Way Down.

[Verse 2]
A vending machine is buzzing like a wasp,
a taxi hunts the exit and gives up.
I text you that the arcade sounds enormous,
you send a photo of your ceiling and a heart.
I keep the screen lit in my coat pocket,
which means I'm walking this the long way anyway,
and saving Sunday for your hand inside my sleeve.

[Instrumental Break - 12 bars]

[Final Chorus]
All the Way Down,
the roof holds every step above my head,
the gate at the far end lets the streetlight in,
I'll see you here on Sunday when it's loud,
and this time I won't leave space between us,
All the Way Down.

[Verse 1]
Six months of walking you home from your corner,
six months of turning back at the same lamp.
Tonight my hand is resting on your latch,
and I have not moved it, and you have not moved either.
There's a crate of bottles somebody left,
a bicycle chained up against the meter,
and every sentence I rehearsed has gone quiet
because your face is closer than the words.

[Chorus]
So say it plain while she is here,
Hand on the Gate,
six months is long enough to hold a question,
and your hand is close enough to make me brave.

[Verse 2]
You don't answer with a yes or with a no.
You put your hand right next to mine and wait,
then let one finger rest across my knuckle,
and the latch stays cold while everything else warms.

[Final Chorus]
Hand on the Gate,
the beat comes back but neither of us moves,
say it plain, a door is not an ending,
six months is long enough to hold a question,
your hand answers mine before your voice does,
and I don't have to walk back down alone,
Hand on the Gate.
